Fist Callaway is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three.
“
The Flaming Fist don't stand for trouble. So stay out of it, yeah?
„
— Callaway

Involvement

Callaway is stationed in the Flaming Fist Office together with  Fist Loudstone and  Fist Broko, under the command of  Manip Cragbender. He is guarding the stairway leading down to the Wyrm's Rock Prison and is not too eager to talk.
